_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

Fixes #35792

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: 7033659866 — the maintainer's choice on a decision card in the project's cost-review thread, 2026-11-20T07:44:37Z, verbatim and untranslated: option 「只看大小,p1 只管先后」, whose stated consequence reads 「S 卡用子代理,M 卡有区进区,大卡才一卡一线程;有披露纪律的安全卡仍留座位。要立卡改技能这一行。」 (ruling record comment 7033659866 on the routing card it names).

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:车队调度技能里,分区原先把所有安全卡一律交回席位,现在只交回带披露纪律的那一类,其余安全卡按大小照常分流。
- 落实维护者「只看大小,p1 只管先后」的裁决,与上一轮已改好的卡线程规则对齐,补上那次没改到的分区规则。
- 只影响调度代理怎么分流卡片,不碰产品代码;出错可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`, the 留道 line: the hand-out closed set `交出闭集` now reads `他道在线席已认领、cloud 路由、披露纪律卡、ADR` instead of `…、安全、ADR`. The term `披露纪律卡` is the one the card-thread section of `references/dispatch-runbook.md` defines (private detail may not leave the seat session), so the two files now agree; a security card without that discipline is routed by size like any other card, because the set is closed.
- Byte ratchet at headroom 0, no ceiling raise: the +9 bytes are paid for by joining three wrapped list continuations in the same file (the 留道 item's two continuations and the 同系列卡 item's one), which deletes their newline-plus-indent and changes no word. File stays 6586 bytes, ceiling 6586.

Read first (by risk): the 留道 hunk (the one meaning change); the 同系列卡 hunk (whitespace-only join).

## Acceptance notes

Sweep of `area-lease.md` for any other line that hands a card out of an area for being `security` alone — none found, nothing else changed:
- the 不入区 line (big cards, queue watch): size and lane, not security;
- the 认领前三查 line (遇大卡 ⇒ 交席位): size;
- the 取卡 line (p0/p1 插队): order only;
- the 席信箱 line (`安全照 security-findings.md`): routes security FINDINGS to the private-report path, it does not hand a card out of an area.

## Tests

Text-only change to a governed skill reference; no tested behaviour moved, so no ablation.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `grep -n 交出闭集 .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md` prints the line ending `cloud 路由、披露纪律卡、ADR。`; `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` prints `area-lease.md is 6586 bytes (ceiling 6586; headroom 0)`.
